subject.title: Sidebar session groups cannot be renamed, deleted, kept empty, or turned off

question: Should OpenClaw accept sidebar-level custom group management plus a persisted flat-list toggle, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117 remain the implementation path after its review gaps are addressed?
rationale: The requested behavior adds user-facing UI management and a persisted browser preference, and the issue already carries protected maintainer and product-decision labels.

options.title: Continue the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117 as the candidate fix after its proof and session-enumeration concerns are resolved.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Accept only group rename/delete or empty-group rendering and defer the flat-list toggle if maintainers want less new preference surface.

options.title: Reject sidebar management
options.body: If sidebar group management is not desired, close both the issue and linked PR with a product-direction rationale and leave grouping management on the Sessions page only.

recommendation.title: Continue the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117 as the candidate fix after its proof and session-enumeration concerns are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the current sidebar grouping implementation and the open linked PR.
